# Media Hero

Component ID: media-hero

## Purpose and selection

- Explore one supplied or sourced local image whose visible detail supports narration.

Do not use:

- Do not use a decorative pan for code or charts, fabricate factual imagery, or crop away critical evidence.

- title: Supply real title within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
- supporting: Supply real supporting line within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
- mediaUrl: Existing nonempty project-relative assets/ image; preserve provenance in the storyboard and identify illustrative imagery.
- label: Supply real label within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.

## Reading order and motion

- Orient in the image
- Inspect actual detail while text stays fixed
- Read the interpretation
- Settle on the evidence

Pattern: camera-journey. Native default duration: 10s. Minimum final readable hold: 0.7s.

### explore

- Target: .mh-image
- Visible action: Move gently within the actual image while preserving screen-fixed text
- Authored start: 1.2s; action duration: 3.4s.
- Narration cue: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Move gently within the actual image while preserving screen-fixed text. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.

### explain

- Target: .mh-supporting
- Visible action: Reveal the supporting narration
- Authored start: 4.8s; action duration: 0.6s.
- Narration cue: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Reveal the supporting narration. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.

### resolve

- Target: .mh-image
- Visible action: Settle on the evidence and hold
- Authored start: 8.6s; action duration: 0.55s.
- Narration cue: At the concluding narration clause, settle the shown evidence; allow the authored final reading hold.

These are authored event defaults, not measured speech alignment. Rebind active events to actual narration at project FPS; omitted capacity items must not acquire phantom cues. Preserve source easing, internal timing ratios and landing geometry. Source implementation is authoritative for curves not declared in the manifest; this card does not invent calibrated parameter ranges.

## Known failure modes and recovery

- overflow: Split at a real semantic boundary or use a more suitable component; never truncate items or shrink text until unreadable.
- missingInput: Reuse or obtain a scoped authorized image; if unavailable choose another validated recipe or report the missing asset, never fake imagery or unapproved custom graphics.
- timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once, preserving order, authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary when the sequence cannot fit; do not stretch speech or create a frozen tail.
- inapplicable: Choose another validated recipe whose narrative job fits, split at a meaningful boundary, or report the library gap. Under recipes-only policy, never author custom graphics or force-fit content.

Under recipes-only policy, missing capability means another validated recipe, a meaningful split or an explicit gap; not custom graphics disguised as reuse.
